original_text: Ah, that was a friendly. Let's be careful.
zhtw: 啊，那是友軍。我們小心點。

original_text: Whoa, we hit a teammate!? Let's change our line!
zhtw: 哇，我們打到隊友了！？換條路線吧！

original_text: Be careful not to hit our allies.
Ammo rack hit. Watch it doesn't detonate!
zhtw: 彈藥架被擊中。小心別引爆！

original_text: Ammo rack damaged. The next hit could be bad.
zhtw: 彈藥架受損了。下一擊可能很糟。

original_text: Not good. The ammo rack's damaged.
Ammo rack took a hit. Let's handle this carefully.
zhtw: 彈藥架中彈了。我們小心處理。

original_text: We hit them, but it wasn't enough.

zhtw: 嗯，被他們的裝甲擋住了。

original_text: Mm, ricochet. Let's shift position next time.
zhtw: 嗯，彈開了。下次換個位置。

original_text: They had a good angle on that one.
Maybe we hit the wrong spot.
It's okay. Stay calm and go again.
Keep hitting them. We'll crack it!
Let's make the next one count.
Ah, I got hit! I'll leave the rest to you.
zhtw: 啊，我被打中了！剩下的交給你們。

original_text: Ouch, I think I need a break!
What's the point of all this if we have to retire?
zhtw: 如果要退場，這些還有什麼意義？
這裡是豹獅隊。我們退場了。

original_text: Back to the pits this time.
We'll go even harder next time!
Not a direct hit, but we rattled them.
zhtw: 雖然不是直接命中，但震到他們了。

original_text: That was close. I'll load the next shell!
Next one will be a direct hit!

zhtw: 駕駛員被擊中！我們掩護她！

original_text: They are targeting the driver's seat. Watch out!
They're burning. Hit the sweet spot.
zhtw: 他們燒起來了。打中要害了。

original_text: Fire started. That'll shake them up.
They're on fire. It's wearing them down!
zhtw: 他們起火了。這會消耗他們！

original_text: Nice, we'll keep the pressure on.
Nice, let's go all the way!
Enemy vehicle destroyed. That's one down.

zhtw: 這裡是豹獅隊。敵車摧毀。

original_text: Engine damaged! We can't move so fast.
zhtw: 引擎受損！我們不能跑太快。

original_text: Hit to the engine. I'll go pacify her.
zhtw: 引擎被擊中。我去安撫她。

original_text: Engine's not right. Hey, come on, move it!
zhtw: 引擎不對勁。喂，快點動啊！

original_text: They went for the engine. Smart shot.
zhtw: 他們瞄準引擎。射得聰明。

original_text: We can still move, but let's not push it.
zhtw: 我們還能動，但別太勉強。

original_text: We can't move! We're an easy target now!
zhtw: 動不了了！我們現在是活靶！
我們動彈不得。挺糟的吧？

original_text: Guess our run ends here. Repair the engine, fast!
zhtw: 看來這趟到此為止。快修引擎！

original_text: We're burning! Stay calm and put it out.
Bad news, this is beyond a pit stop!
zhtw: 糟了，這不是進站能解決的！

original_text: Whoa, this is way past overheating!
That burning smell... we're really on fire!
zhtw: 那燒焦味…我們真的起火了！

original_text: All right, we can run again!
Fuel tank hit! Watch for fire.
We may have a fuel leak...
Fuel tank's hit. Sparks are the last thing we need.
zhtw: 油箱中彈。最不需要火花了。

original_text: Careful here. If it ignites, we're in trouble!
zhtw: 小心。如果起火就麻煩了！

original_text: Gunner's station hit! Hoshino, you okay?
zhtw: 砲手座被擊中！星野，你沒事吧？

original_text: Ouch...let me take a rest for a bit.
They hit our gun! Accuracy will be reduced.
zhtw: 他們打中主砲！精準度會下降。

original_text: Gun's not feeling right. Let's shoot carefully.
zhtw: 主砲感覺不對。我們小心射擊。

original_text: Main gun destroyed! I can't fire!
So, the gun's gone. That's a serious problem.
Loader's station hit. Suzuki, take it easy.
zhtw: 裝填座被擊中。鈴木，放輕鬆。

original_text: Radio operator's seat is hit. Comms will be rough.
zhtw: 通訊員座被擊中。通訊會很困難。

original_text: The radio station took a serious hit.
Radio damaged. Coordination is getting harder.
zhtw: 無線電受損。協調變難了。

original_text: Hit to the radio. It's harder to get our voice through.
zhtw: 無線電被擊中。聲音很難傳出去。

original_text: Radio took a hit. We'll have less info from allies.
zhtw: 無線電中彈。友軍情報會變少。

original_text: There's something wrong with the radio.
Warm-up's over! Time for the real run!
zhtw: 熱身結束！真正的跑開始了！

original_text: Nice, we're going flat out from the start!
zhtw: 不錯，我們從一開始就全速！

original_text: Checks are done, loaded and ready.
All right! Let's make this a clean run!
I won't let you pass through here.
zhtw: 我不會讓你們從這裡通過。

original_text: Keep the drifting under control? Uh... I'll try!
Please really keep it under control!
Roll out! Let's keep both engine and motor intact.
zhtw: 出發！引擎和馬達都保持完好。

original_text: That's not possible with a tank.
We had Katsu curry bento. We can't lose!
zhtw: 我們吃了豬排咖哩便當。不能輸！

original_text: Feels like the race is on.
Leopon is in a good mood today.
Let's see what kind of run we can show today.
zhtw: 看看今天能跑出什麼樣的表現。

original_text: Why don't we try Accel Back?
That's a local technique in Rally.
zhtw: 那是拉力賽的本地技巧。

original_text: We've gotten used to driving a tank, huh?
zhtw: 我們已經習慣開戰車了吧？

original_text: This is a rough road to drive over considering how heavy our tank is.
zhtw: 以我們戰車的重量，這路況挺難開的。

original_text: It's better than the rally in Greece.

zhtw: 他們瞄準我們的瞄準鏡。
他們瞄準我們的瞄準鏡！

original_text: It's okay. We can still see!
Reduced view is never a good thing.
zhtw: 視野變窄從來不是好事。

original_text: Observation gear destroyed! We can't see outside.
zhtw: 觀測裝置摧毀！外面看不見了。

original_text: Optics are completely out! We've lost our view.
zhtw: 瞄準鏡完全壞了！視野沒了。

original_text: Can't see much. Repair the optics, fast!
They got our optics. We can't see outside!
zhtw: 他們打壞瞄準鏡。外面看不見了！

original_text: Observation device is broken. Let's repair it now!
zhtw: 觀測裝置壞了。現在修吧！

original_text: Somebody fix our observation device, fast!
Observation gear restored. We can see now.
zhtw: 觀測裝置恢復。現在能看見了。

original_text: View range is back. Good save.
Emergency repair done. Our sight is back.
zhtw: 緊急修復完成。視野恢復了。
瞄準鏡恢復。我們回來了！

original_text: Okay, visibility is back to normal.
Our vision's back, we're still in this!
Lost them. Don't force the chase.
Drop that one. On to the next.
No need to stick on this one.
Let someone else deal with them.
Our allies can handle that one.
Tracks took a hit. Should we make a pit stop now?
zhtw: 履帶被擊中。現在進站嗎？

original_text: They hit the tracks. Next hit could be bad.
zhtw: 他們打中履帶。下一擊可能很糟。

original_text: Track damaged. We can make an early pit stop.
zhtw: 履帶受損。我們可以提早進站。

original_text: They are targeting our tracks. Watch out!
zhtw: 他們瞄準我們的履帶。小心！

original_text: They got our running gear. Repair it fast.
zhtw: 他們打壞行走裝置。快修。

original_text: Tracks are destroyed. Let's fix them.
zhtw: 履帶被摧毀。我們修好它們。

original_text: Tracks restored! We can move again!
zhtw: 履帶恢復！我們又能動了！
修復完成。我們可以出發了。

original_text: Come on, no time to stay parked!
Still got some running to do.
They hit the traverse system. Don't rush it.
zhtw: 他們打中轉動系統。別急。

original_text: Traverse restored. We can realign now.
zhtw: 轉動恢復。現在可以重新對準。

original_text: I guess the race is over for us, huh?
zhtw: 這場比賽我們結束了吧？

original_text: Uh oh, we can't carry on!
Team-Leoponsan here. We are done for, sorry.
zhtw: 這裡是豹獅隊。我們結束了，抱歉。

original_text: We'll stay up all night tonight and get those tanks back in running order.
zhtw: 今晚我們通宵把戰車修好。
